verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents concrete AI features that generate suggestions from the customer's own data, e.g. First Pass AI pre-screening evidence for audit issues and GenAI-based autofill for due-diligence questionnaires, plus an AI Helpbot. These qualify as AI-generated insights/suggestions inside the product, but the evidence is mostly marketing copy without detail on how insights are surfaced (e.g., dashboards, proactive risk analysis) beyond evidence QA and questionnaire autofill. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of AI insight quality, broader coverage of AI-driven analytics (e.g., risk scoring, trend detection) beyond evidence/questionnaire use cases.
